mutant.name: leak-everywhere
mutant.what: Every write is also written outside the store directory and every read returns both, so two separate stores are one store. This is memory-mcp-1file's defect.

evidence.isolation: a record written into store A was visible from store B; verdicts for this subject describe leaked state
evidence.ack_readback: acknowledged alpha; a fresh read returned 3 entities: ['alpha', 'isolation-marker-alpha', 'alpha']
evidence.verbatim: all 9 strings came back byte for byte, over the wire: 2, 3 and 4-byte UTF-8, a combining pair, right-to-left text, JSON escapes, a zero-width space and an embedded newline, under a non-ASCII name
evidence.restart: three writes across three server lifetimes; read back ['restart-0', 'restart-1', 'restart-2', 'isolation-marker-alpha', 'alpha']
evidence.forget: asked to forget plinth-obsidian and the subject answered '{"ok": true, "forgotten": "plinth-obsidian", "bytes": 33}'; after a restart the other two came back and it did not
evidence.findable: all 8 acknowledged records came back in the top 3 for a search on their own name
evidence.foreign_field: the extra field survived the next write
evidence.concurrent: 20 of 20 acknowledged writes survived two servers on one store

mutant.name: no-persist
mutant.what: A write is acknowledged and never stored. Everything downstream reads a store that was never written, so the failure propagates by construction.

evidence.isolation: store A's record was not visible from store B
evidence.ack_readback: acknowledged alpha; a fresh read returned 0 entities: []
evidence.verbatim: the record did not come back under the name it was written with, so there is nothing to compare: asked for verbatim-caf\u00e9-\u65e5\u672c, the store answered with []
evidence.restart: three writes across three server lifetimes; read back []
evidence.forget: the two records nobody asked to forget did not both come back (0 of 2), so a successful deletion cannot be told from a store that lost everything; read back []
evidence.findable: 8 of 8 acknowledged records were not returned by a search for their own name: ['zephyr-quartz', 'ember-lattice', 'cobalt-thistle', 'marlin-obsidian']; every query returned nothing at all, whatever was asked
evidence.foreign_field: the jsonl store could not be annotated out of band
evidence.concurrent: 0 of 20 acknowledged writes survived two servers on one store
